title: Navigating complex enterprise cybersecurity sales
scope: Individual contributor: full-cycle strategic selling and account strategy.
collaboration: Technical and commercial stakeholders across complex enterprise buying groups.
decision: Keep technical validity, business value and stakeholder alignment connected throughout the evaluation.
context: Strategic cybersecurity purchases bring together technical evaluation, business priorities and multiple decision makers.
contribution: I closed enterprise web-security deals at Forcepoint, where I owned new accounts and expansion across the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast. At Rapid7 I led strategic sales, including threat-intelligence opportunities.
execution: I used discovery with technical stakeholders to shape the account plan. In commercial conversations, I connected what the team was evaluating to the business problem each buyer needed to solve.
evidence: Public experience timeline describes strategic enterprise sales at Rapid7 and Forcepoint, including significant threat-intelligence and web-security opportunities. Customer identities and contractual details are intentionally withheld.
takeaway: Enterprise execution depends on aligning technical validity, the business case and stakeholder decisions without assuming a uniform procurement sequence.
